common_symptoms: fever, malaise, headache, regional lymphadenopathy, cutaneous lesion with surrounding edema or vesicles, black eschar, chest x-ray evidence of mediastinal widening, acute onset of fever, dry cough, hilar or mediastinal adenopathy and lung infiltrates
affected_organs: skin (cutaneous disease), respiratory system (inhalational disease), central nervous system (meningitis)
risk_factors: exposure to contaminated mail or powder, working in a high-risk environment (postal workers, media corporations)
preventive_measures: screening for suspicious letters or powders, personal hygiene, avoiding contact with unknown substances
diagnosis_challenges: nonspecific symptoms, lack of early biomarkers, disease mimics
treatment_challenges: drug resistance, frequent relapse, side effects, poor adherence
